0.desc: You come across an unconscious guy in an alley. Blood. A knife nearby.
0.c0msg: You find {{cr}} credits. You leave quickly.
0.c2msg: You walk past. Not your problem.

1.desc: Two gangs face off in the corridor. You're in the middle. Neither is looking at you yet.
1.c0msg: You back off. They start fighting each other. You slip out the other side.
1.c1msgWin: They listen to you. +15 rep, a few credits as thanks.
1.c1msgLose: They don't listen. You take a few hits leaving.
1.c2: Use the chaos to loot the crates behind
1.c2msg: You slip away with {{cr}} credits. They saw nothing.

2.desc: You find an abandoned travel bag. Someone left in a hurry.

4.desc: A child silently hands you something. An energy crystal. They vanish before you can speak.
4.c1: Look for them to return it
4.c1msg: Nowhere to be found. The crystal stays in your hand.

5.desc: An empty corridor. Graffiti. A smell of burnt metal. Nothing else.

6.desc: Credits scattered on the floor. Someone made a run for it.

7.desc: A locked door with a broken electronic panel. The contents could be interesting.
7.c0msg: You force it. Your shoulders will remind you tomorrow. +credits.
7.c2msg: You move on. It probably wasn't worth anything.

8.desc: Strobing lights. Voices barking orders. A raid. You're in the wrong alley at the wrong time.
8.c0: Try to flee into the crowd (30% success)
8.c0msgWin: You vanish into the chaos. A few baton hits along the way. -HP.
8.c0msgLose: They caught you. Off to the station.
8.c1msg: They escort you out of the zone. An interrogation awaits.
8.c2msg: They overpower you. You wake up in a cell covered in bruises.

9.desc: A dead-end corridor. Someone made it that way on purpose. The 'Exit' sign pointed the wrong way.
9.c0msgWin: A technical gap. You squeeze through. -HP.
9.c0msgLose: They were waiting for you. The cage closes.
9.c1msg: Armed people arrive. No questions asked.

0.desc: An old, forgotten coin. Sentimental and market value.

1.desc: A traveling merchant offers his services. His prices seem reasonable.

2.desc: Children play in a lit corridor. Someone laughs. The universe isn't always dark.

3.desc: A forgotten first-aid kit behind a kiosk.

4.desc: An old pilot tells you about a secret trade route. Sounds legal.

5.desc: An open café. Real coffee. You sit for five minutes. It feels good.

6.desc: A poorly secured fuel tank. No one's watching.

0.desc: A crate of spare parts. Sellable value.

1.desc: Discarded manufacturing scraps. Salvageable.

2.desc: A worker blocks your path. 'Restricted zone.' He looks exhausted, not aggressive.
2.c0fail: Not enough credits. You turn back.
2.c1msg: You leave through the other entrance.

4.desc: Machines running. Heat. Noise. Nothing useful here.

5.desc: Components fallen off a line. Still good.

6.desc: Unwatched fuel canisters in storage. You take two.

0.desc: An unsealed safe. Probably forgotten for years.

1.desc: Ruins of a former shop. Still-active holograms display prices from another era.
1.c1: Take a hologram as a souvenir

2.desc: Collapsed corridors. Twisted beams. The story of a catastrophe no one tells anymore.

4.desc: A pre-war object. Its function is no longer clear.

5.desc: You find a still-active terminal. Partial data. Someone was looking for something.
5.c1msg: You erase everything. Sometimes it's better not to know.

6.desc: The floor lets out a dull crack under your foot. A split second to understand. Then the void.
6.c0: Grab a beam as you fall (20% survival)
6.c0msgWin: You catch yourself. Your shoulder pops out of its socket. You survive. Barely.
6.deathCause: Structural collapse in the ruins. The floor gave way without warning. No one will ever know.

7.desc: Three shapes emerge from the shadows at once. Armed, coordinated. Someone was waiting for you to walk in here.
7.c0msgWin: You make it out. So do they. You flee, bleeding.
7.c0msgLose: They got you. You wake up in a cell, lighter on credits.
7.c1msg: You raise your hands. They take you away without a word.

1.desc: A soldier stares you down. His hand rests on his weapon. He's waiting for you to justify your presence.
1.c0msgLose: He escorts you out by force. -HP.
1.c1msg: You back off. He watches you until you're out of sight.
1.c2msg: He pockets it without a word and looks away.
1.c2fail: Not enough credits. You back off.

2.desc: A partially looted armory. A few credits remain in the till.

3.desc: Abandoned ammunition in a decommissioned corridor.

4.desc: Empty rooms. Boots echoing somewhere. You don't linger.

0.desc: A wallet forgotten on a bench. A rich person who won't miss it.

1.desc: A wealthy client approaches you. He wants discretion and service. He pays well.
1.c0msg: +500cr. You don't ask questions. -5 moral rep.
1.c1msg: You decline. He nods and disappears.

2.desc: An open bar. You help yourself discreetly. No one's watching.

3.desc: A luxury pharmacy with unsecured inventory.

4.desc: An underground arena tournament. Spectators. High stakes.

0.desc: An implant prototype in an unsealed box. Someone forgot to put it away.

1.desc: A panicked scientist runs after you. 'Help me. They're coming.' He's holding something important.
1.c0msg: +20 rep. He thanks you with everything he has. +credits.
1.c0journal: I helped a scientist on the run. He was afraid of something — or someone. He gave me everything for his freedom.
1.c1: Take what he's holding and leave
1.c2msg: You walk past. His shouts fade away.

2.desc: A research grant in untraceable cash credits. In an open locker.

3.desc: Empty labs. Half-finished experiments. No one to tell you what they were.

4.desc: A research terminal with unencrypted data. You copy what you can.

0.desc: A messenger wearing Cesarion's colors hands you a package. 'Drop this off at Raphazarus's depot. He mustn't know it's from us.' The package is sealed.
0.c0msg: Delivered. Cesarion now sees you as trustworthy. Raphazarus... knows nothing. For now.
0.c1msg: Raphazarus appreciates your loyalty. Cesarion's messenger won't be back.
0.c2msg: You walk on. The messenger disappears into the crowd.

1.desc: Eliotis left research data on an open terminal. Maxance is looking for it — he wants it destroyed before it spreads.
1.c0msg: You secure the data. Eliotis will know you protected it.
1.c1msg: Maxance nods. The data disappears. Eliotis will never know.
1.c2msg: No one gets anything. No thanks, no grudge.

2.desc: Alanossa and Scotty are fighting over control of a trade corridor. Each wants you to testify in their favor before the station council.
2.c0msg: Alanossa wins the vote. Scotty gives you an icy look. +5 rep.
2.c1msg: Scotty controls the corridor. Alanossa won't forget. +5 rep.
2.c2msg: Both think you're a coward. -3 rep.

3.desc: An agent of Raphazarus offers you a contract: sabotage a delivery meant for Alanossa. Generous pay.
3.c0msg: The delivery will never arrive. +400 cr. Raphazarus is pleased.
3.c1msg: Alanossa tightens her security. Raphazarus loses an agent — and a bit of trust in you.
3.c2msg: Not your problem. The delivery goes ahead. Or not.

4.desc: You overhear a conversation between one of Maxance's lieutenants and a Cesarion contact. A clandestine exchange of information. They haven't seen you.
4.c0msg: Eliotis pays well for this kind of intel. +200 cr.
4.c1msg: They pay. Dearly. But they won't forget you.
4.c2msg: You saw nothing. Better this way.

0.title: An envelope for you
0.desc: A kid hands you a crumpled envelope. 'Someone paid me to give you this.' He vanishes before you can answer.
0.c0empty: The envelope is empty. A setup? You can't tell.
0.c0qDesc: The envelope contains precise coordinates and an instruction: retrieve the package on {{target}} and bring it back here. No name, no explanation.
0.c0msg: Coordinates on {{target}}. Someone wants you to retrieve something there.
0.c1: Burn the envelope without opening it
0.c1msg: You get rid of it. It smelled like a trap — or worse, an obligation.

1.title: Old pilot and forgotten routes
1.desc: An old pilot grabs your arm in the corridor. 'I've flown everywhere. There's a station nobody visits anymore. Good reasons — and abandoned resources.' He just wants it remembered.
1.c0noTargetMsg: He tells you about it. Interesting but not directly usable. +5 rep.
1.c0qDesc: The pilot described a station he believes was abandoned: {{target}}. 'Check if that's still true. If not, that changes everything.'
1.c0msg: He describes {{target}} precisely. A solid lead. +5 rep.
1.c1msg: He nods. You leave. He goes back to his drink.

2.title: Merchant under pressure
2.desc: A traveling merchant quickly packs up her goods when she sees you. 'The local guys are back in an hour. If you need anything, it's now or never.'
2.c0msg: She packs up two boxes fast. -120cr, +2 Medicine.
2.c0fail: Not enough credits. She shakes her head and packs up.
2.c1: Ask why she's in a hurry
2.c1noTargetMsg: She tells you about her situation. Rough. You help a little. +8 rep.
2.c1qDesc: The merchant has stock stranded on {{target}}. She can't go herself. 'If you're passing through, you'd be doing me a huge favor.' Pays well.
2.c1msg: She needs something delivered on {{target}}. +8 rep for listening.
2.c2msg: You walk past. Not your problem.

3.title: Merchants' dispute
3.desc: Two merchants are screaming at each other. One accuses the other of falsifying delivery data. They're looking for a neutral witness — or someone to settle it.
3.c0qDesc: The merchant you sided with entrusts you with a delivery. 'I remember people who helped me.' Headed to {{target}}.
3.c0msgWin: You settle it. One of them was wrong, and knows it. The winner thanks you. +12 rep.
3.c0msgLose: You take a side and both turn on you. Sometimes the arbiter loses too. -5 rep.
3.c1msg: He slips you a few credits discreetly. The loser holds a grudge. -8 rep.
3.c2msg: You go around. Not your circus.

4.title: Mechanic short on parts
4.desc: A mechanic calls out from his improvised workshop. 'I need someone to pick up parts from another station. I pay well, I don't have time to go myself.'
4.c0noTargetMsg: He has no parts to bring in. Maybe another time.
4.c0qDesc: The mechanic needs specific components from {{target}}. 'It's urgent, my client's been waiting three days.' Payment on delivery.
4.c0msg: He gives you the details. Components from {{target}}. Clear job, honest pay.
4.c1msg: He shrugs. He'll find someone else.

5.title: Drunk with good intel
5.desc: A drunk guy in a corner mutters names, stations, numbers. He looks like he worked for someone important — and had too much to drink to keep quiet about it.
5.c0: Listen carefully (and buy him a drink, 40cr)
5.c0failMsg: Not enough credits to keep him talking. He falls asleep.
5.c0noTargetMsg: He rambles. Nothing usable. -40cr for nothing.
5.c0qDesc: The drunk mentioned unusual activity on {{target}}. Worth checking out. 'If it's true, someone will pay a lot to know.'
5.c0msg: He mentions {{target}} several times. Something's going on there. -40cr, interesting lead.
5.c1msg: He falls asleep on his own. Probably nothing useful.
5.c2msg: A few credits in his pockets. He'll wake up none the wiser. -10 rep.

6.title: A merchant intercepts your path
6.desc: He gets up from his table before you even walk past him. 'I've got a contract to offer — transport, nothing complicated. But I want a good price and no questions.' He looks in a hurry.
6.c1msg: He shrugs and sits back down. Maybe another time.

7.title: Broker looking for a reliable pilot
7.desc: A woman in a dark suit watches you from the bar. She sets down her glass and walks over. 'I hear you make good runs. I have a delicate shipment. Terms are negotiable — now, here.'
7.c1msg: She notes your refusal with mild surprise. +2 rep (she respects people who know how to say no).

0.title: Bounty hunter with a list
0.desc: A guy stares at you from the entrance. He's got a laminated list. He checks your face. His gaze lingers.
0.c0msgWin: You blend into the crowd. He loses sight of you.
0.c0msgLose: He catches up with you in an alley. Brief scuffle. You get away, so does he. -HP.
0.c2noTargetMsg: He agrees to let you go. -300cr. Bad investment.
0.c2qDesc: The hunter offered you a shared target on {{target}}. 'I take half, you take the other.' He seems serious.
0.c2msgWin: He hesitates, then extends a hand. He shares a bounty on {{target}}. +5 rep.
0.c2msgLose: He's not interested in partnering. -300cr to make him look elsewhere.
0.c3msg: -300cr. He puts away his list without a word. Transaction.
0.c3fail: Not enough credits. He keeps watching you.

1.title: Contact in a raincoat
1.desc: A man approaches without meeting your eyes. 'I have a package. I need a courier who doesn't ask questions. Fair pay, moderate risk.' He hands you an envelope with the details.
1.c0qDesc: The contact entrusted you with a sealed package to deliver on {{target}}. He won't say what's inside. 'Total discretion. Payment on arrival.'
1.c0msg: Package received. Destination: {{target}}. What's inside, you don't know — and you'd rather not.
1.c1msg: He takes the envelope back. 'You're not the right profile.' He disappears.
1.c2msg: He leaves without pushing. People like that have options.

2.title: Neighborhood boss
2.desc: The local boss plants himself in front of you with two muscle-bound men behind. 'Toll for passage. This is my territory.' His look says he's done this a thousand times.
2.c0fail: Not enough credits. He gets more threatening.
2.c0qDesc: The boss let you through and kept your name. 'If you need clean work, come find me.' He's got an operation on {{target}} that needs an outsider.
2.c0msg: -200cr. He lets you through. 'Next time you might have something to do for me.'
2.c1msgWin: He backs off. He knows people who don't bend. +15 rep.
2.c2msgNo: He laughs. 'You've got nerve.' He lets you through for free. This time.
2.c2qDesc: The boss accepted the trade. He gives you a target on {{target}} instead of the toll. 'Make them understand they belong to me too.'
2.c2msg: He thinks it over and agrees. A job on {{target}} in exchange for the toll.
2.c3msg: Your tone makes him step back. He lets you through. +25 rep.

3.title: Faction defector
3.desc: A woman pulls you into an alcove. She's sweating. 'My own people are hunting me. I can give you information in exchange. Real information. About a target a lot of people want.'
3.c0noTargetMsg: She talks. Names, places. Nothing immediately usable, but +10 rep.
3.c0qDesc: The defector gave you an address on {{target}} and a name. 'This person has blood on their hands. And someone is paying to end it.' She won't say more.
3.c0msg: She gives you a target on {{target}}. Precise. Documented. +10 rep.
3.c1: Turn her in to the authorities (+credits, -rep)
3.c1msg: +credits. She watches you leave. That look will stay with you. -20 rep, 'informant' tag.
3.c1journal: I turned in a defector to the authorities. She watched me leave without a word. That look doesn't fade.
3.c2msg: She disappears into the crowd. You keep going. Maybe the right call.

4.title: Informant with a bounty
4.desc: A nervous man approaches and talks fast. 'You look capable. There's an open bounty on a target in the sector. The big houses don't hunt in this territory. You could, if you're interested.'
4.c0noTargetMsg: He can't give you usable details. 'Sorry, bad timing.'
4.c0qDesc: The informant gave you a target on {{target}}. 'Move fast. Other hunters are on the trail.' His nervousness seems genuine.
4.c0msg: Target identified on {{target}}. A serious bounty if you get there first.
4.c1qDesc: The informant first wants active presence on {{target}}. 'Confirm the target's still there. I'll split the bounty after.'
4.c1msgQuest: He first proposes recon on {{target}} before revealing the real target.
4.c1msgNo: He looks at you and leaves. 'You're too cautious for this job.'
4.c2msg: You walk past. He'll find someone else.

5.title: Unsecured transit corridor
5.desc: A dock technician calls out from a walkway. 'If you're leaving soon, avoid the north route — floating debris since yesterday's explosion. Be careful.' He hands you a hand-annotated sector map.
5.c0: Take the map and navigate now
5.c1msg: You note the info mentally. +3 rep — the locals trust you.

6.title: Pilot in distress in the sector
6.desc: The distress signal is weak but clear. Someone's stuck between two unstable zones. Your route passes through there anyway. You can attempt navigation — or ignore it.
6.c1msg: You cut the signal. He'll manage. -5 rep.

0.title: Ambush assassin — bad surprise
0.desc: You see him in the reflection of a metal panel. A split second. He's got a knife. He was waiting for someone — maybe you, maybe not.
0.c0msgWin: You throw yourself aside. He misses. You run. He doesn't press it.
0.c0msgLose: He grazes you. Painful. You get away. -HP.
0.c2qDesc: The assassin talked under pressure. Someone from {{target}} ordered the hit. Maybe not you as the target — but someone nearby. The lead is hot.
0.c2msgWin: He talks. A target on {{target}}. +15 rep, -HP (short struggle).
0.c2msgLose: He resists. You got him but he says nothing. -HP. Nothing usable.

1.title: Faction recruitment — not really a question
1.desc: Three men surround you. One wears a faction emblem. 'We're looking for competent independents. You look like one. This is an offer — but not the kind you easily refuse.'
1.c0noTargetMsg: They have nothing concrete to give you here. They slip you an advance. +400cr.
1.c0qDesc: The recruiters gave you a demonstration mission on {{target}}. 'Show us you can do the work. Expected result: one opponent neutralized on site.'
1.c0msg: A test mission on {{target}}. If you succeed, they come back with a serious offer. +400cr advance.
1.c1: Negotiate — demand a bounty for information
1.c1msgFail: They don't appreciate the negotiation. Short lesson. -HP.
1.c1qDesc: The recruiters accepted the deal. They want you to retrieve something on {{target}} and you get your bounty. 'No one else but you for this.'
1.c1msg: They reluctantly accept the deal. An extraction on {{target}} in exchange for a good bounty.
1.c2msgWin: They stare at you for a long time. Then they step back. 'You've got backbone. We'll be back.'
1.c2msgLose: The refusal goes badly. They give you a taste of it. -HP.

2.title: Exhausted double agent
2.desc: A man in a dark corridor waves you over. His eyes are those of someone who hasn't slept in a long time. 'I have information on an ongoing operation. I can't use it myself. Someone can — for a price.'
2.c0fail: Not enough credits. He leaves without a word.
2.c0noTargetMsg: -600cr. The info is vague but relevant. +20 rep in the underworld.
2.c0qDesc: The double agent sold you precise info on a high-value target on {{target}}. 'Move fast before things change.' The info seems reliable.
2.c0msg: -600cr. Target identified on {{target}}. High bounty if you act fast. +20 rep.
2.c1: Refer him to the proper authorities
2.c1msg: He nods. He knew it could end this way. +8 rep for honesty.
2.c2msgCaught: He catches on before you have time. He disappears. -15 rep. These people share information.

3.title: Mercenary down
3.desc: A mercenary is leaning against the wall, a hand on his side. Blood. He looks up. 'I need help. You look like you know what you're doing. I can pay — not in credits, in information.'
3.c0noMedsMsg: You have no medicine. He nods. 'Not your fault.'
3.c0qDesc: The mercenary gave you the names of those who set him up on {{target}}. 'If you pass through there, return the favor.' Gratitude in return.
3.c0journal: I treated a wounded mercenary in the wreckage. His name was Cador. He gave me a lead in exchange.
3.c0msg: You treat him. He holds on. In exchange, he gives you a lead on {{target}}. +18 rep, -1 Medicine.
3.c1msg: You walk past. He says nothing. That image will stay with you.
3.c2: Search him if he passes out (–rep)
3.c2journal: I searched a wounded man as he passed out. I'm not proud of that.
3.c2msg: +credits. -18 rep. 'Opportunist' tag. You knew what you were doing.

4.title: Information on Alanossa
4.desc: A source contacts you from the shadows. 'I have information on Alanossa. Real movements, not rumors. It costs — but it's worth the price.'
4.c0qDesc: The source gave you a window of opportunity on West Apocalypse Arc. 'Alanossa will be exposed. Briefly.' An exceptional bounty awaits whoever acts.
4.c0msg: Alanossa on West Apocalypse Arc. Short window. -700cr, +30 rep in the underworld.
4.c1msgFail: She's not in the mood. She leaves. This information has a fixed price.
4.c1msgWin: -400cr. She agrees to a partial summary. +15 rep.
4.c2msg: She shrugs. 'Someone else will take the bounty.'

5.title: Ambush — no warning signs
5.desc: You're walking. There's no one around. Then there's someone. A bag over your head. Hands behind your back. Someone's done this thousands of times.
5.c0msgWin: You break free in total chaos. You run. You're bleeding. You're out. -HP.
5.c0msgLose: You wake up in a cell. Wallet empty. No one knows you're here.
5.c1msg: They take you in. Methodical. You lose credits and your freedom.

6.title: Booby-trapped cargo
6.desc: An abandoned crate in a corridor. Too well placed. You approach. You crouch. You open it.
6.c0deathCause: Booby-trapped cargo. The explosion caught you by surprise in a dangerous-zone corridor.
6.c0msgGas: Sleeping gas. You wake up in a cell, disoriented.
6.c0msgCredits: Real credits. You don't understand. You don't try to.
6.c1: Back away and don't touch it
6.c1msg: You step away. Someone else might have less self-control.

7.title: ID check — plainclothes agents
7.desc: Two strangers politely block your path. 'Your papers.' No visible badge. They don't need one — their attitude is enough.
7.c0msgInterrogation: They look over your papers and signal a third man. Off to the interrogation post.
7.c0msgPass: They check and let you through. A file has just been opened on you, somewhere.
7.c1msgWin: They let you go. This time.
7.c1msgLose: Refusing to cooperate goes badly. They pin you down before you finish your sentence.
7.c2msgWin: You run. They don't follow. Maybe they had other things to do.
7.c2msgLose: Fleeing was the wrong call. There were others in the corridor.

0.title: Price on your head
0.desc: A stranger has been following you since the entrance. When you turn around, he smiles. "You've got {{repAbs}} less reputation. Someone pays well to know where you are." He discreetly shows a weapon.
0.c0: Pay him to keep quiet (300 cr)
0.c0msg: He pockets it. He disappears. For how long?
0.c0fail: Not enough. He sends you a physical warning before disappearing.
0.c1msgWin: He backs off. It was a bluff. But now he knows you hold your ground.
0.c1msgLose: It wasn't a bluff. You barely make it out but you pay dearly.
0.c2msgWin: You lose yourself in the packed corridor. He loses your trail.
0.c2msgLose: He catches up with you. One hit. He drops you and disappears.

1.title: Refused service
1.desc: A proprietor recognizes you the moment you walk in. "Sorry, we don't serve people like you here." He signals his goons. "Your reputation precedes you — and not in a good way."
1.c0msg: They escort you out. -5 rep. You pick up a bit of info on the way.
1.c1: Invoke your past reputation (if you have any)
1.c1msgWin: You bring up a few good deeds. The proprietor hesitates. He reluctantly agrees. +3 rep.
1.c1msgLose: He laughs. Your 'past reputation' is worthless here. You leave humiliated. -8 rep.
1.c2msg: You leave. This station isn't for you. Not right now.

2.title: Toxic transaction
2.desc: A shadow dealer approaches you. He knows who you are — and figures someone with your reputation is surely after shady stuff. He offers black-market implants at a bargain price.
2.c0msgWin: +12 max HP. The implant takes. Not bad for the black market. -200 cr.
2.c0msgLose: The implant rejects. -HP, -200 cr. The dealer's already gone.
2.c1msg: He tells you about useful contacts in the gray zone. +5 rep in the underworld.
2.c2msg: You walk past. Not the day to mess with the black market.

3.title: Old enemy
3.desc: Someone stares at you from the other end of the corridor. You recognize them — or they recognize you. A face from a station you'd rather have forgotten. They walk toward you. Calm. Determined.
3.c0msgWin: The confrontation turns into a cold peace. They leave. Something settled. +8 rep.
3.c0msgLose: It escalates. You get away but it's ugly. -HP, -10 rep.
3.c1msgWin: They listen. Really listen. You gain something rare: a second chance. +15 rep.
3.c1msgLose: They won't listen. 'You should've thought of that before.' They leave, disgusted. -5 rep.
3.c2: Quickly walk off in the opposite direction
3.c2msg: You avoid the confrontation. For now. But the alleys are small.

4.title: Traveling rumors
4.desc: Two people talk about you without seeing you — or pretend not to. What you hear isn't flattering. Your name is circulating in the wrong category. You choose how to react.
4.c0msgWin: You step in with confidence. People listen. The story changes. +12 rep.
4.c0msgLose: You lose your cool. It turns into a public incident. -8 rep. You leave in shame.
4.c1: Deliberately fuel the rumor (rep goes down)
4.c1msg: You play into your bad reputation. Someone pays you for a dirty job. -5 rep, +credits.
4.c2msg: You walk past without a word. The rumor will keep going without you.

lowHp.title: You look rough
lowHp.desc: A field medic notices you passing by. 'You look like you need urgent care. I can do something — but I don't work for free.'
lowHp.c0msg: +40 HP. Makeshift care but effective. -150 cr.
lowHp.c0fail: Not enough credits. He nods and leaves.
lowHp.c1msgWin: +20 HP. He remembers people with a good reputation.
lowHp.c1msgLose: He smiles politely. 'Your reputation doesn't earn you any favors.' He leaves.
lowHp.c2msg: He nods and leaves. The void heals no one.

cargoTheft.title: Eyes on your hold
cargoTheft.desc: You notice two guys scoping out your ship from the dock. They pretend not to look. They're looking.
cargoTheft.c0msgWin: Your reputation discourages them. They leave. +5 rep for holding your ground.
cargoTheft.c0msgLose: They feel entitled facing someone with your reputation. Your hold is empty when you get back. -3 rep.
cargoTheft.c1: Watch discreetly and catch them in the act
cargoTheft.c1msgWin: You wait for them. You confront them. They leave their gear behind as they run. +10 rep, +credits.
cargoTheft.c1msgLose: Too late. They were smarter. Your hold is empty.
cargoTheft.c2: Move your ship to another hangar
cargoTheft.c2msg: 80 credits to switch docks. Expensive but safe. -80 cr.

pickpocket.title: Quick hands
pickpocket.desc: You feel something. A brush. A lightness in your pocket you shouldn't have noticed this soon.
pickpocket.c0: Chase after them (50% chance to catch up)
pickpocket.c0msgCatch: You catch up with them at the corner. They drop {{stolen}} cr and bolt. You get it all back.
pickpocket.c0msgMiss: Too slow. {{stolen}} cr gone into the crowd.
pickpocket.c1msgLost: {{lost}} cr are missing. You noticed the theft too late.
pickpocket.c1msgNothing: Nothing missing. Maybe you imagined it.

reputationPreceded.title: Your reputation preceded you
reputationPreceded.desc: A pilot approaches you. "I heard about you on {{station}}. Someone said you'd passed through there." He seems to be waiting for something.
reputationPreceded.c0noTargetMsg: You share. He listens. Your traveler's reputation is useful. +8 rep.
reputationPreceded.c0qDesc: The pilot has an urgent package to deliver on {{target}}. He doesn't have time. You do.
reputationPreceded.c0msg: He offers you work. +8 rep for the conversation.
reputationPreceded.c1msg: He was looking for someone trustworthy for a message. He hands it to you. +3 rep, an encrypted note in your pocket.
reputationPreceded.c2msg: You dodge the questions. He understands. He leaves.

deepLoot: Rewarded depth. A real treasure down there.

0.title: Marek's workshop
0.desc: Marek is in his workshop, hands elbow-deep in a stripped-down propulsion engine. He glances up for a second. 'You need something or are you just looking?'
0.c0: Ask him if he has work
0.c0noTargetMsg: He's got nothing concrete for you right now. But he notes your name. +5 rep.
0.c0qDesc: Marek needs specific components from {{target}}. 'Those parts, I can't find anywhere here. You've got a ship.' Fair payment on delivery.
0.c0msg: Marek has an order on {{target}}. Simple delivery, honest pay.
0.c1msg: He talks while he works. Stories about The Wreckyard no info board would tell. You leave with useful intel. +8 rep, some credits.
0.c2: Offer to help with the repair
0.c2msg: Two hours later, the engine runs. He takes a look at your ship in return. +12 rep, free repairs.

1.title: The unlabeled meat
1.desc: A vendor sells grilled meat from a cart. Smells good. No label. No questions. A kid in front of you buys three portions without a second thought.
1.c0: Buy some and don't ask where it's from
1.c0msg: It's good. You try not to think about it too much. +HP, -30cr.
1.c1: Ask where the meat comes from
1.c1msg: He looks at you. He doesn't answer. The kid looks at him too. You move on.
1.c2: Report it to The Wreckyard's authorities
1.c2msg: The Wreckyard's authorities? Good joke. There isn't really such a thing.

2.title: The kids of the holds
2.desc: A group of children blocks your path in a narrow corridor. They look like they're playing — but their formation is too precise to be a game.
2.c0msg: You give them something. The formation opens up. They run this corridor better than any militia.
2.c1msgFound: The alternate path goes through an abandoned section. You find something useful there.
2.c1msgNothing: The alternate path is longer and leads nowhere interesting.
2.c2msg: They agree. Within two hours, they've sent you three useful rumors. +10 rep.

0.title: Boro in a corner
0.desc: Boro leans against a wall in an alcove, eyes half-closed. He sees you approaching from ten meters away. He's always been more observant than he looks.
0.c0: Ask what he has to sell
0.c0qDesc: Boro has a package to move on {{target}}. 'Nothing illegal. Well, nothing too illegal.' He pays well. No receipt.
0.c0msg: Boro has a transport job. {{target}}. He gives you an advance.
0.c1: Ask him for information on the area
0.c1msg: Boro knows everything that moves through the Undercroft. He gives you a solid lead. +6 rep, +credits.
0.c2msg: He watches you leave. He remembers who stops and who doesn't.

1.title: The Undercroft code
1.desc: You've broken something without knowing it — too direct a look, too well-used a corridor. Three people block you now. Not aggressively. Just present.
1.c0: Acknowledge the mistake and offer compensation
1.c0msg: You catch on fast. You pay. The situation defuses. -credits, +5 rep (you know how to behave).
1.c1msgLose: Willful ignorance is the worst insult possible here. -10 rep.
1.c1msgWin: Either you really look innocent, or you convinced them. They step aside.
1.c2msg: Asking directly means respecting the rules. They explain. You apologize. Situation resolved. +8 rep.

2.title: The bottom of the bottom
2.desc: A hidden staircase leads to a level even lower than the Undercroft. The neon lights don't reach down there. People live there anyway.
2.c0msgWin: You find an even more informal market. Things no one sells officially. +credits, +data.
2.c0msgLose: The people here don't appreciate visitors. You leave with bruises. -HP.
2.c1: Go back up — some places don't deserve to be found

0.title: A Black Hawk sizing you up
0.desc: A man in Black Hawk uniform watches you from the entrance of a corridor. He's not threatening. He's assessing. He decides something about you in under ten seconds.
0.c0: Hold his gaze and keep walking
0.c0msg: You pass. He nods, almost imperceptibly. You just accomplished something. +10 rep.
0.c1noTargetMsg: He listens. He says little. Before leaving, he slips you something. +5 rep.
0.c1qDesc: A Black Hawk recognized you as capable. He wants something on {{target}}. 'No need to know why. Need to know if you're reliable.'
0.c1msg: He has a mission on {{target}}. You look reliable. +8 rep.
0.c2msg: He notes that you changed direction. He notes everything.

1.title: Alanossa's network of children
1.desc: A twelve-year-old kid hands you an envelope without a word. On the envelope: nothing. He vanishes into the crowd before you can ask a question.
1.c0noTargetMsg: Credits and a note: 'You're being watched. Keep behaving well.' +500cr.
1.c0qDesc: The envelope contains a photo, a name, a station: {{target}}. No explanation. The reward is real.
1.c0msg: A target. A station: {{target}}. The reward is real — if you trust the source.
1.c1msg: You get rid of it in the first corridor. Someone watches you do it. They pick up the envelope.

2.title: Cael in his corner
2.desc: Cael sits alone at a table in a dark corner. He watches you approach with the patience of someone who decided long ago what he'd do if you came near.
2.c0qDesc: Cael has an operation underway on {{target}}. He tests you by trusting you with it. 'If you fail, I never spoke to you.' If you succeed, you have a positive debt with the Black Hawks.
2.c0msg: Cael talks little. But he gives you something on {{target}}. +5 rep.
2.c1: Don't approach — Cael isn't met by accident
2.c1msg: You keep going. Probably not the right moment.

0.title: Neva in the shadow of corridor 4
0.desc: Neva watches you from a dark alcove. She doesn't try to hide — she gives you time to decide whether to come or not.
0.c0qDesc: Neva needs you to show up on {{target}}. 'I have my reasons. You have the means to go there.' She pays for facts, not rumors.
0.c1: Nod from a distance and keep going
0.c1msg: She nods. That's enough. Purgatory has its codes. +4 rep.

1.title: A former prisoner with a debt
1.desc: An old man stops you. 'You've got the look of someone who's also gotten out of somewhere.' He has the eyes of someone who counted the bars. He wants to talk.
1.c0qDesc: The old man left something on {{target}} when he had to leave in a hurry. 'I can't go back. You can.' He tells you exactly where to look.
1.c0msg: He had something to retrieve on {{target}}. He can't go himself. +8 rep.
1.c1msg: He nods. 'No one has time here.' He leaves.

2.title: The forbidden level 7
2.desc: A door marked 'Level -7 — Restricted access' is ajar. Someone forced the lock from outside. Recently.
2.c0: Go in and see what's there
2.c0msgWin: An old detention room. Belongings left by the last prisoners. Some have value. +credits, +artifacts.
2.c0msgLose: Someone's already there. They don't appreciate being disturbed. -HP.
2.c1: Report the open door to Neva
2.c1msg: Neva appreciates it. She knows level 7. And now she knows you're someone she can tell things to. +12 rep.
2.c2: Close the door and move on
2.c2msg: Someone wanted that door open. You just disrupted their plans.

0.title: Torvak on break
0.desc: Torvak eats alone in the cafeteria. He eats slowly, methodically, like someone who's learned to savor moments of silence.
0.c0: Sit at his table and talk to him
0.c0qDesc: Torvak has unfinished business on {{target}}. He can't go — he's on duty. 'If you pass through, return my compliment.' He tells you exactly how.
0.c0msg: Torvak talks little but every word counts. He gives you a lead on {{target}}. +10 rep.
0.c1: Leave him be — some silences deserve respect
0.c1msg: You move to another table. He glances up for a second, then back down. You just scored a point. +5 rep.

1.title: A recruit who wants to desert
1.desc: A recruit approaches you in a side corridor. She's young. She looks like she made up her mind seeing you. 'Are you leaving soon?'
1.c0qDesc: You have a deserter aboard. She wants to go to {{target}}. Fort Kharos authorities might be looking. No detours.
1.c0journal: I took a Fort Kharos deserter aboard. She was fleeing something heavier than me. I helped her.
1.c0msg: She boards. You now have a deserter aboard and a destination on {{target}}.
1.c1: Advise her to leave through other means
1.c1msg: You give her names, routes. She thanks you. +6 rep.
1.c2: Report her — you don't want trouble
1.c2msg: The militia takes her. A reward lands in your pocket. -15 rep, +300cr.

0.title: Lira cracked something
0.desc: Lira approaches you with the look of someone who just did something she shouldn't have. 'I got access to a system. I saw things. I need it not to get around.'
0.c0: Listen and keep it to yourself
0.c0qDesc: Lira identified valuable data on {{target}}. 'I can't show up there myself. You have a ship.' She tells you exactly what to look for.
0.c0msg: Lira entrusted you with something. She has a job on {{target}}. +8 rep.
0.c1: Sell the information to her rivals
0.c1msg: +credits. Lira will know. She always knows. -25 rep.

1.title: A hacker actively fleeing
1.desc: A guy runs down the corridor, terminal under his arm, eyes everywhere. He bumps into you, stares for a second, and resumes running, muttering 'sorry' without stopping.
1.c0qDesc: The hacker needs to leave Nexus Aldara fast. He knows things people don't want him to know. {{target}} is the plan. Payment on arrival.
1.c0msg: He needs to head to {{target}}. Fast.
1.c1: Ignore him — his problems aren't yours
1.c1msg: He disappears down a side corridor. You hear sounds of pursuit ten seconds later.

0.title: Pistis on level 9
0.desc: Pistis is in a café on level 9 — where the lighting is dim and the signs more discreet. He waves you to sit before you even ask.
0.c0: Sit down and see what he's got
0.c0noTargetMsg: Pistis has contacts everywhere. He slips you some sellable information. +400cr, +8 rep.
0.c0noTargetJournal: I met Pistis on level 9. He slipped me info without looking me in the eye. This guy has contacts everywhere.
0.c0qDesc: Pistis has something to deliver on {{target}}. 'Nothing illegal. Well, nothing the law can prove.' He pays above market for discretion.
0.c0journal: I met Pistis on level 9. He had a delivery. I didn't ask what it was.
0.c0msg: Pistis has a delivery for {{target}}. He pays well. +8 rep.
0.c1msg: He understands. 'You'll be back.' Probably true. +3 rep (you know what you're doing).

1.title: An auction on level 7
1.desc: A guarded door, a hum of voices behind it. Someone's selling something the official levels don't see. The door is ajar during the guard change.
1.c0msgWin: You seem to belong. An artifact sale. You leave with something valuable. +credits, +artifact.
1.c0msgLose: They know you don't belong here.
1.c1msg: You identify faces, alliances, prices. Sellable information. +5 rep, +credits.

0.title: Rook at work
0.desc: Rook is forging something. The sound is steady, almost hypnotic. He doesn't look up when you enter. He knows you're there.
0.c0fail: You need at least 800cr for an order from Rook.
0.c1: Bring him rare materials in exchange for work
0.c1qDesc: Rook needs specific materials from {{target}}. 'I craft better with better raw materials. You bring it, I forge, you leave with something good.'
0.c2msg: He forges for an hour. You watch. At the end he shows you something — a technique. +8 rep.

0.title: Automated sentinel — no hesitation
0.desc: A mechanical hum in a side corridor. A gyroscope. A cannon. It turns toward you before you understand what it is.
0.c0msgWin: You avoid the worst of it. The burst grazes you. You run without looking back. -HP.
0.c0deathCause: Automated sentinel in The Lost Arc. Pre-war system. No conscience. No mercy.
0.c0msgLose: The cannon didn't hesitate. You did.
0.c1: Raise your hands — maybe there's a surrender sensor
0.c1msgPrison: The system surrounds and escorts you. You end up in a cell. Raphazarus's soldiers arrive later.
0.c1deathCause: The sentinel had no 'surrender' mode. The Lost Arc wasn't built to take prisoners.

1.title: Raphazarus's soldiers — silent patrol
1.desc: Four men in heavy armor, no clear insignia. They walk without speaking. They spotted you thirty seconds ago. They're waiting for you to make a move.
1.c0: Identify yourself and ask to pass
1.c0msgPass: One of them signals to let you through. Not a word. A test passed, you don't know why.
1.c0journal: Raphazarus's patrol let me pass. Not a word. They looked at me as if they knew something I don't.
1.c0msgInterrogation: They escort you. No force. 'You have questions. So do we.'
1.c0msgPrison: One of them wasn't waiting for your answer. You wake up in a cell in The Lost Arc.
1.c1msgWin: You run through the wreckage. They don't chase far. You get away, barely. -HP.
1.c1msgLose: They ran faster than you thought. The ruins hold no secrets for them.
1.c2msgInterrogation: 'You're coming with us.' No violence. Just certainty.
1.c2msgPass: They pass. One of them looks at you a second too long. Then they disappear into the ruins.

2.title: Uncharted radiation zone
2.desc: A corridor deep in the ruins. The walls change color — a faint, almost beautiful glow. Something radiates in there.
2.c0deathCause: Lethal radiation in an uncharted zone of The Lost Arc. Fatal dose within minutes.
2.c0msgDeath: You move forward. The pain starts five minutes later. You don't come back out.
2.c0msgHurt: You recover pre-war artifacts. And nausea that won't fade anytime soon. -HP, +2 Artifacts.
2.c0msgJackpot: An armored capsule. Protected by the hull. Data from before the Great War. Priceless. +credits, +data.
2.c1: Stay outside — wait for the glow to fade
2.c1msg: It doesn't fade. You leave. These zones aren't visited without equipment.

0.title: Ganz has a proposal
0.desc: Ganz intercepts you near the casino entrance. He smiles but his eyes are calculating. He always has a proposal.
0.c0noTargetMsg: He tests your interest. No concrete mission tonight. But he remembers you listened. +5 rep.
0.c0qDesc: Ganz wants an active presence on {{target}}. Some of his clients come from there. 'I pay for concrete.' He pays well.
0.c0msg: Ganz wants {{target}} watched. Serious pay. +5 rep.
0.c1: Politely decline and head to the casino
0.c1msg: He laughs. 'Good idea.' He lets you through. +2 rep.
